sloka: वाहनानि च सर्वाणि सा त्यक्त्वा वै समन्ततः ।पर्वताभोगविवरे तस्मिन्रेमे इला तदा ।। ७.८८.७ ॥
transliteration: vāhanāni ca sarvāṇi sā tyaktvā vai samantataḥ ।parvatābhogavivare tasminreme ilā tadā ।। 7.88.7 ॥

translations.english: Then, Ilā, having completely abandoned all her conveyances, delighted in that wide mountain cavity.
